cards.answer: Sì, ho un fratello più grande.
cards.notes: Do you have brothers or sisters? / Yes, I have an older brother.
Are you married? / Yes, for fifteen years. A man is sposato.

cards.answer: Sì, due: un maschio e una femmina.
cards.notes: Do you have children? / Yes, two: a boy and a girl.
How old are they? / Twelve and fifteen.
What's your husband's name? / His name is Marco.
Do you live near your parents? / No, they live in another city.
Who do you look like? / I look like my mother.
What a lovely photo. Who is it? / It's my grandmother, when she was young.
Do you have any pets? / Yes, we have a dog.
How's your family? / They're all well, thanks.

cards.prompt: Tua figlia va ancora a scuola?
cards.answer: Sì, ma l'anno prossimo va all'università.
cards.notes: Is your daughter still at school? / Yes, but next year she's going to university.

cards.answer: Sì, a Natale siamo sempre tutti insieme.
cards.notes: Do you spend the holidays together? / Yes, at Christmas we're always all together.
